notes: Portuguese now opens with a free A0: ten lessons of the Portuguese you actually need as a visitor. Ordering a coffee and a pastel de nata, paying, asking the way, buying a ticket, eating out, shopping, asking someone to slow down, and what to say if something goes wrong. Whole phrases, no grammar tables. The rest of the course is unchanged and simply moves ten lessons later, so nothing you have studied is lost. Both courses now give away all of level A0.
